title: SEO Basics: How to Rank Higher on Google in 2026
excerpt: The simple foundations that move your site up the search results.
content: Ranking starts with understanding what your customers search for. Build pages around those questions and answer them clearly.
Fast loading, clean structure and useful content do more for your rankings than any trick.

title: Website Speed vs Conversions: Why Every Second Counts
excerpt: Slow pages lose visitors. Here is what to fix first.
content: Visitors leave slow websites quickly. Even a one second delay can reduce sign-ups and sales.
Compress images, reduce scripts and use a fast host. Measure again after every change.

title: PPC Budgeting for Small Businesses: Where to Spend First
excerpt: Start small, test fast and put money behind what works.
content: Begin with one clear goal and a small daily budget. Test a few ads before you scale anything.
Track cost per lead, not clicks. Move budget to the campaigns that bring real customers.

title: A Simple Social Media Content Plan You Can Actually Follow
excerpt: Plan a month of posts without burning out.
content: Pick two or three content themes and post on a steady schedule rather than every day.
Reuse your best posts in new formats, and reply to every comment in the first hour.

title: Email Marketing Basics: Turn Subscribers into Loyal Customers
excerpt: The emails every small business should send first.
content: Start with a welcome email, then share useful tips before you ask for a sale.
Keep subject lines short and honest, and clean your list every few months.

title: Write Website Copy That Speaks to Your Audience and Converts
excerpt: Clear words beat clever ones, every time.
content: Lead with the benefit to the reader. Say what you do, who it is for and what to do next.
Use short sentences and one clear call to action on every page.
